scope: Active non-archive literature, decisions, design, formal model, statistical plan, reviews, execution plan, and Q1 gate after RACER, CONCUR, Selective Deferred Routing, Solo.io quota-management, Keel Budget Envelopes, and AgentBudget updates.

findings.summary: Dispatched expiry, timeout, disconnect, missing usage, and ambiguous delivery retain unresolved liability across rollover; release requires atomic pending-outbox cancellation or authoritative unbilled proof.
The current corpus and all independent reviews are bound to the exact literature corpus hash after R52-R57 removed algorithmic and systems-integration novelty.
Review gates require critical and major findings to be resolved, not merely accepted, and validate all required review artifacts against the current corpus.
The Q1 gate reruns the committed formal checker, verifies the model hash, required semantic invariants, transition coverage, and empty failure set rather than trusting a stale results label.
ADR 0003 and the active design remove new-router and integration novelty; the implementation is an experimental vehicle for only the problem formulation and comparative measurement study.

Request, fixed-opportunity-cohort, selected-outstanding-set, and tenant-window events are defined separately; the common-G theorem uses predictable admission indicators and selected-route bounds, follows by conditional union bound and iterated expectation, and does not transfer to selected sets or windows.
Strict safety is labeled conditional ledger feasibility and enumerates provider-cap, billable-category, finality, pricing, serialization, and gateway-bypass assumptions.

The pre-outcome statistical plan uses hierarchical independent units, matched streams, faithful practical and academic comparators, exact rare-event bounds, multiplicity control, and explicit null-result retention.

The operational falsifier requires frozen matched-risk rules, equivalence or noninferiority margins, Pareto or scalar decisions, and removal of advantage language when practical envelopes or adaptive quantiles match.
Pinned R55 source facts are reproducibly hash-checked, while the possible concurrent-settlement double-charge race is explicitly an inference pending a faithful pinned-code test.

The literature validator requires resolved-only corpus-bound bibliography, novelty, and scientific reviews, post-material saturation, named closest work, unique verified IDs, and at least 40 live-reachable primary records.
Explicit outbox pending, claimed, delivered, and canceled states make claim and cancellation mutually exclusive; a late claim after atomic expiry cancellation is rejected.

Provisional settlement retains residual correction exposure until authoritative finality; after rollover a temporary guard keeps exposure at the original reservation, carried debt remains non-negative, and historical downward-correction credit is audit-only.

The schema-v4 bounded formal model uses explicit effect counters, tenant and workload identities, representative wrong-principal actions for every mutating API shape, same-tenant concurrency traces, nine required scenarios, and required transition coverage.
A historical downward correction changes origin-window audit credit only; it cannot offset carried debt or increase admission availability in the current or a later budget window.

The theorem indexes a pre-outcome arrival-opportunity cohort, makes admission and route choice predictable, assigns a pathwise capped risk allocation without redistributing rejected-slot weight, and gives dynamic active-set allocation no fixed-cohort theorem.

Correction inbox entries bind event ID to immutable request, version, and value payload; an exact replay is acknowledged without a second posting even after later correction versions, while conflicting or stale payloads are rejected.

approved_contribution_boundary: Problem and safety formulation separating non-equivalent monetary risk events with assumption-scoped ledger invariants and the common-G fixed-cohort union bound.

Preregistered comparative measurement of risk-utilization, isolation, drift, faulty-event behavior, liveness cost, and local overhead against faithful practical envelopes and strong academic baselines.
progression_verdict: Phase B literature and novelty and Phase C formulation/theory are approved for progression. This is not approval of implementation, protocol freeze, experiments, manuscript, or release; their Q1 gate obligations remain pending.
